findings.title: Built-in `handoff` signature waives the whole round on one matching line, and `: Permission denied` is far too broad
Gap attribution's "named" route matches a bare basename anywhere in output, laundering ordinary failures (e.g. `cargo test` printing `target/debug/deps/…` while `target/` is the open gap)
`drive_dispatch`'s gap note/journal path has no test, and re-journals an `intervention` on every `reuse` dispatch
